profile.summary:
Coder-turned-PM-turned-coder again because I build & ship amazing product faster than I drive cross-functional alignment or whatever. Building software for aerospace. I <3 having absurdly smart customers.

Amateur distance runner, film fanatic, D&D geek.

positions.title: Senior Product Manager, Clinical Product Analytics
positions.description: Designed and built the first interactive clinical opportunity model for large plan care management across the Aetna / CVS portfolio.

positions.title: Head of Product
positions.description: Moved to India to co-direct a product studio for early-stage local startups. Raised wages 19%, cut work hours 18%,  and closed gender pay gap by level. Restructured business to drive 160% increase in revenue from clients.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
Designed and shipped Nuna's first product for hospitals and health systems from zero to one. Built on top of the CMS referral patterns dataset for Medicare, it identifies instances where patients don't have clear accountable physicians managing their care. Health systems use the product to find these gaps and improve care coordination.

Built claims analytics products for self-insured employer clients, including biometrics, population health profiles, wellness program analysis, cost & utilization, and top providers.

Defined and launched Nuna’s unified claims and enrollment schemas, through which our analysts, data scientists, and API pulled all commercial claims, reducing query creation and receipt time by 70-80% as reported by analysts and data scientists.

Joined as a software engineering intern in 2014, and saw the company grow from 8 employees to 150+ in 4 years.

positions.description:

4 quarters CS181: Computers, Ethics, & Public Policy
